course.title: Elements of Civil Engineering Structures
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A simply supported beam of a span of 16 ft carries a uniformly distributed load of (25) 1.5 kip/ft including its own weight. The beam is to be designed with reinforced concrete having rectangular cross-section. Design the beam by WSD method for the following data: $t _ { \mathsf { s } } = 1 8$ ksi; $r _ { \mathrm { c } } = 2$ ksi; $R = 1 6 6$
